statement: /Kaggen (the Mantis) is the central trickster-creator figure in /Xam narrative as recorded in the Bleek-Lloyd archive: shapeshifting (mantis, eland, snake, louse, hare), morally ambiguous rather than purely benevolent, central to the eland-creation narrative — he made the first eland from a piece of shoe leather nurtured with honey, and wept when it was killed by his in-laws, his released tears/gall creating the first darkness.

sources.citation: Bleek, Wilhelm, and Lucy Lloyd. Specimens of Bushman Folklore. 1911.
